61:1: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth glorifies Allah. He is al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
61:2: O you who believe, why do you say that which you will not do?
61:3: That you say that which you will not do is met with great hatred in the sight of Allah.
61:4: Indeed, Allah loves those who fight in His way forming ranks as if they were a solid building.
61:5: And when Moses said to his people: 'O my people! Why do you harm me? Whereas you knew that I am Allah's messenger to you.' So when they deviated, Allah made their hearts deviate. Allah does not guide the people of the fasiqun.
61:6: And when Jesus son of Mary said: 'O Children of Israel! Indeed, I am Allah's messenger to you, confirming the Torah before me and giving good tidings of a messenger to come after me whose name is Ahmad.' But when he came to them with clear proofs, they said: 'This is clear magic.'
61:7: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah while being called to Islam? Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
61:8: They want to extinguish Allah's light with their mouths, and Allah is the completer of His light, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
61:9: He is the One Who sent His messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religions, even though the polytheists dislike it.
61:10: O you who believe! Shall I show you a trade that will save you from a painful punishment?
61:11: You believe in Allah and His Messenger, you strive in jihad in the way of Allah with your possessions and your lives; if you know, this is better for you.
61:12: He will forgive your sins and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow and beautiful dwellings in the Gardens of Adn. That is the great salvation.
61:13: And another thing that you love: help from Allah and an imminent victory. Give good tidings to the believers.
61:14: O you who believe! Be helpers of Allah, just as Jesus son of Mary said to the disciples: 'Who are my helpers for Allah?' The disciples said: 'We are the helpers of Allah.' Thereupon, a group from the Children of Israel believed and a group disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemies, and they became dominant.
